newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: German arrested in Colombia for sex crimes.
newsitem.headline: German arrested in Colombia for sex crimes.

text.p: A fugitive from German justice has been arrested in Colombia on child pornography charges, authorities said on Thursday.

The DAS state security police said 54-year-old Peter Schnaubelt, a German national wanted for sex crimes in Berlin, was arrested on Wednesday at his home on the outskirts of the northwest city of Medellin.

Abundant pornographic material seized in the home, where Schnaubelt had apparently lived since he arrived in Colombia in July, provided "bloodcurdling" evidence of his sexual abuse of minors, including his own 10 and 14-year-old children, the DAS statement said.

The material included videotapes and photographs of Schnaubelt having sex with children. The material had been packed for shipment to Europe, it said, adding that this led authorities to link him to an international child pornography ring headed by Jean Manuel Villaume, a Belgian national who operated out of Colombia and was arrested in France last year.
A German Embassy source confirmed an arrest order had been issued in Berlin for Schnaubelt, who is wanted there for "sexual crimes with minors."

"It's a very big case," the source said, adding that Schnaubelt was known by law enforcement officials throughout Europe. But it was not immediately clear if Germany had requested Schnaubelt's extradition.

Relations between Bonn and Bogota have been strained since November when German private detective Werner Mauss and his wife Isabel Seidel were arrested as they tried to smuggle another German, Brigitte Schoene, out of Colombia three months after she was abducted by leftist guerrillas.

The couple have been held in a Medellin prison ever since on charges of being foreign operatives for the guerrillas, but the German government has insisted they were carrying out a "humanitarian" mission.
